items.title: Cohomological descent for the comparison of the ph-topology with the small etale topos
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the ph-topology analogue of the cohomological descent statement, for complexes with torsion cohomology sheaves (statement lines 22440-22448). The proof (proof lines 22450-22478) follows the same pattern as in the h and fppf cases: reduction to a single sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma, rewriting of the composite pushforward through the description of the pullback, and degeneration of the relative Leray spectral sequence using the V-C statement and the etale descent. H2: one reduction plus one spectral sequence degeneration, written out.
